home.badge: Every rental protected · deposits held, never charged
home.headline:
Rent what you need,
earn from what you own.
home.subhead: From drills and tents to pro cameras, lenses and instruments — borrow gear from people near you, or list yours and get paid.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Three steps from "I need it" to "I've got it".
home.step1Desc: Search nearby listings by category, dates and price. Filter everyday gear or pro equipment.
home.step2Desc: Pick your dates and request to book. You're not charged until the owner accepts.
home.step3Desc: Meet the owner, grab your gear. A refundable deposit is held — never charged — and released on return.
home.trust1Desc: Every booking is covered up to €5,000 against accidental damage.
home.trust2Desc: Pay through Trodplas. Money is released to owners only after pickup.
home.trust3Desc: ID-checked owners and renters, with ratings on every profile.
home.ctaBannerDesc: List it in minutes and earn from what you already own. You set the price and the deposit.
